info.cls_ename: College of Information and Electrical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程主要設計給大學部工程與科學科系初級學生提升數學思考與解題能力，以應付未來更進一步的課程進修。針對於常微分方程式求解方法的介紹與分析，此課程的內容主要包含一階、二階微分方程求解、拉普拉斯轉換與冪級數等議題。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed for the beginning undergraduate engineering and science students who need to enhance mathematics skills in preparation for studies. To introduce and analyze methods of solving ordinary differential equations, the topics include first-order differential equations, second-order differential equations, Laplace transform, and series solutions.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解微分方程式及拉普拉斯變換的特性。
targets.describe_en: Comprehension for the characteristics of differential equations and Laplace transform.

targets.describe_ch: 能應用微分方程式以解決科學或工程問題。
targets.describe_en: Apply differential equations to solve the problems in science or engineering.

targets.describe_ch: 能分析一個線性系統計算程序，並得出其解。
targets.describe_en: Analysis for the calculating procedures in a linear system, and to obtain the solution.

2. If you are requesting leave, please apply for leave in accordance with Feng Chia University’s leave regulations.

4. If you have any questions, you can raise your hand and ask at any time.

二、若有任何問題，可以在請益時間到我的辦公室請益。
三、請善用資訊電機學院安排的課後輔導時間。

2. If you have any questions, you can come to my office during consultation hours.
3. Please make good use of the after-school tutoring time arranged by the School of Information and Electrical Engineering.
